construct_validity.interpretation: These are stop-before-production construct gates, not fitting targets. A scientifically estimated fundamental curve can disagree with KTC, but not by a catastrophic scale/ordering mismatch.
construct_validity.reference: 2027 KTC combined is central market reference; tradesourced<->crowdsourced is the disagreement band.

core_estimator.definition: For each draft year and R1-R4 cell, normalize development_fit_weight_v8 within year/cell and compute weighted arithmetic mean of H3.O2. Final raw cell EV is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of the six yearly cell EVs.
core_estimator.shape_policy: Phase 0 reports raw monotonic violations. Any later monotonic projection must be separately preregistered and cannot be chosen after inspecting KTC residuals.
core_estimator.uncertainty: Joint draft-class bootstrap over the six yearly cell-EV vectors; fixed seed; report 90% and 95% intervals.
core_estimator.validation: Leave-one-draft-class-out predictions using only the other five classes. Report absolute and log-scale error; do not use KTC in fitting.
core_estimator.why: Arithmetic expectation preserves the value contribution of rare elite outcomes that median/MAE targeting suppresses. Equal draft-class weighting prevents classes with more source observations from dominating.

forbidden: fit, rescale, tune, or select the FV estimator using KTC values
reuse 2024 H2 as a fresh holdout
fit six independent R5/R6 cell values
use median or MAE minimization as the primary ex-ante FV target
change player valuation, Package Adjustment, or Team Utility
next_stage_if_phase0_integrity_passes: V10 Phase 1 Core + Tail Candidate Evaluation under this frozen contract
objective: Estimate ex-ante draft-pick Fundamental Value from the distribution of historical rookie outcomes using expected value, not median-like realized-player MAE.
phase0_outputs: raw R3->R4, R4->R5, R5->R6 transition diagnostics
KTC construct-validity diagnostics without market fitting

T2_TWO_FACTOR.win_rule: T2 may replace T1 only if outer-LOYO tail log-RMSE improves by at least 5% AND bootstrap P(T2 lower error than T1) >= 0.80; otherwise T1 wins.

common_rules: Tail begins only after the final Round-4 core FV is frozen.
Carry the final Round-4 early/mid/late proportions forward; do not fit six independent R5/R6 cells.
Estimate decay on log round-mean ratios from historical H3.O2 expected values.
Use nested leave-one-draft-class-out selection for shrinkage; KTC is never used because KTC has no Round-5/6 benchmark.
